services.name: River Runner Private Cruise
services.desc: Introducing our newest addition to the fleet: a 25ft Parker pilot house, perfect for private cruises accommodating up to 6 passengers. This vessel offers a unique and personalized experience, tailored to your preferences. Relax and unwind as you embark on a leisurely boat ride along the picturesque Cape Fear River and Intracoastal Waterway, exploring the scenic beauty of Southport, Oak Island, and Bald Head Island. With a variety of pre-planned routes available, or the option to customize your journey, the possibilities are endless. Our captain typically operates from inside the pilot house, up to 6 passengers 1.5hrs $245
